Title: Massassi's Honor and Change of Target

Messages.Author: Apache Jonas
Messages.Body:
Trying to build a Osebo Operation 419 deck, I stumbled upon Massassi's Honor.

I wonder if it is possible to first play Massassi's Honor and then Change of Target

Osebo A plays 419 operation
Vamp B succesfully blocks
Osebo A plays Massassi's Honor targeting Osebo C
Osebo A plays Change of Target and untaps (and perhaps Vamp B)
Osebo C plays 419 operation

Massassi's Honor
[Action Modifier] Action Modifier
[Osebo] Osebo
Only usable when this Osebo is blocked (play before combat, if any). Choose a ready untapped Osebo you control who could take that action, put this card in play, and move any other cards this Osebo played this action from your ash heap to this card. After this action, the chosen Osebo must attempt the same action (with the same target, if any). He or she may play cards from this card as if from your hand. Burn this card at the end of that action or if the action is not possible

Change of Target
[Action Modifier] Action Modifier
Only usable when this acting minion is blocked (play before combat, if any). Untap the acting minion, do not tap the blocking minion, and end the current action (it is not successful). This minion cannot perform the same action again this turn.

Messages.Author: Dorrinal
Messages.Body: I don't see any card text that would prevent you from doing it.

Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
Hmmm, I hadn't considered adding Change of Targets since I was mainly interested in being able to rush twice with Masassi's Honor.

Nice idea!

Messages.Author: Malachy
Messages.Body:
It's a nice tweak, although I would use a different sequencing...

Osebo plays 419 Operation
Vamp is trying to block
Osebo plays whatever cards she has, like stealth, and if cept shows up, Change of Target, THEN Massassi's Honor. It could make sense, if you use low cap osebo with obf upgrades in which case for one card you'll recycle 2+, and protect your Honored osebo as well.

2-3 of them in such deck might serve it's purpose.

NC of Hungary
